bear_assumptions: China regulation, game or advertising weakness and poor AI-capex conversion compress margins, investee value and the ADR multiple while cash returns slow.
base_assumptions: Games, marketing and fintech sustain growth; AI investment supports engagement over time, margins remain resilient and buybacks continue despite near-term cash pressure.
bull_assumptions: AI materially improves advertising, games and cloud monetization, compute utilization rises, free cash flow recovers and investee value plus buybacks compound per-share earnings.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if cash conversion and an accepted relationship clear every canonical gate; downgrade if AI spending fails to earn returns, regulation or competition impairs core platforms, net cash falls materially, or ADR and China risks worsen.
